summary_full:
NC State Wolfpack at Virginia Cavaliers.

BlueChip leans NCSU. Overall team strength is the clearest signal.

Why NCSU has the edge


BlueChip projection
Market: UVA -5.5
BCW desk μ (home): +5.5 (Research Preview)
Win probability: unavailable until probability model passes validation.

How each team wins
UVA: Stay efficient on early downs and avoid giving the visitor explosive answers.
NCSU: Shorten the game, win the line of scrimmage, and force the favorite into obvious passing downs.

What changed this week
• Final UVA Starting Lineup Projection Before Week Zero Game vs NC State - Sports Illustrated
• College football's mad two-week scramble to land a transfer portal QB
• NC State enters Year 14 under Dave Doeren knowing it has a strength in returning QB CJ Bailey - Times West Virginian
• NC State vs. Virginia odds: 2026 college football picks, Week 0 predictions from proven model - SportsLine

What could make BlueChip wrong?
• Turnovers: the projection assumes roughly normal luck; a +2 swing can flip a NCSU lean.
• Injury / inactive surprise on either OL or QB would rewrite the pass-rush signal.

Bottom line: NCSU has more ways to win on the current MATCHUP SIGNAL board, but football variance (turnovers, explosives) remains large around any margin estimate.

glossary.EPA/play: Expected Points Added estimates how much each play improves expected scoring position. Positive is good. A 5-yard gain on 3rd-and-3 is not treated like 5 yards on 3rd-and-20.
glossary.MATCHUP SIGNAL: A descriptive strength×weakness edge. Not a published win probability and not fed into BCW-RIDGE-v0.1 until validated walk-forward.
glossary.Research Preview: BlueChip quantitative layer that has not cleared the five public ship gates.
